purpose: Canonical provenance manifest for CP8 / ASIN-HHC publication hardening.

repository_strategy.Holbrook-CP8-HHC: Canonical provenance spine: deterministic builds, manifests, hashes, verification, packet bus, chain registry.
repository_strategy.ASIN-HHC-Artifacts: Public portfolio: curated PDFs, visual artifacts, diagrams, and encoded artifact payloads.
repository_strategy.ASIN-HHC-Collaboration: Public audit trail: session logs, decision records, milestones, collaboration chronology.
repository_strategy.cp8-provenance-workspace: Private working repo: drafts, speculative work, experimental notes. Do not publish wholesale.

publication_rules: Keep deterministic provenance centralized in Holbrook-CP8-HHC.
Keep public artifacts curated and externally legible.
Keep collaboration logs separate from technical source.
Keep speculative/private material out of public repos unless intentionally redacted.
